annotations.title: Status of up to 1000 job ids you hold

description: For a local copy of the ledger: send up to 1000 job ids, get each one's current status (live, closed, withdrawn or unknown, exactly what get_job would answer with this key), with closed_at and closed_reason, withdrawn_at and withdrawn_reason, and for a live or closed id content_version, content_changed_at and last_verified_at. content_version changes only when the employer changed the posting's text, so refetch only ids whose version differs from yours. Costs 0.1 record per id, rounded up per call (1000 ids = 100 records). NEEDS a JOA API key on the Growth plan or above, like changes_since (see https://jobopportunitiesapi.org/api for plans).

ids.description: 1 to 1000 job ids (UUIDs), as returned in the id field of search_jobs or get_job.
